verdict: PROVISIONAL — sample below threshold, indicative only

survivorship.forward_universe: current index membership (sp1500 live members at scan time)
caveats: Current-membership scan counts a name that surged BEFORE it joined the index.

Delisted names have no yfinance history → dropped (see dropped_pct); their outcomes (often the worst) never reach EV → EV biased optimistic — this delisted-dropout gap applies INSIDE the sp500_pit cohort too.
The point-in-time was_member gate is now APPLIED — see sp500_pit_cohort (the headline by_tier stays the broader current-membership population).

sp500_pit_cohort.gate: sp500_membership.was_member(ticker, entry_date) is True; entries beyond the vendored snapshot are UNKNOWN and EXCLUDED, never assumed members

ev_caveats: ev_excess_vs_spy is a BETA=1 adjustment; these are higher-beta names, so some 'excess' is beta, not alpha. ev_excess_beta_adj additionally adjusts by each entry's PRE-ENTRY realized beta (250-session, min 60 obs, no look-ahead) — closer to alpha, but beta is itself an estimate; read both.
EV is published GROSS and NET of an ASSUMED 0.50% round-trip cost/slippage (ev_horizon_net / equity_multiple_net); real costs vary with size/liquidity — the assumption is disclosed, not measured.
ev_*_ci90 is a SEEDED 1000-sample bootstrap percentile CI on the mean (5/95) — honest under right-skew. The per-tier readouts are correlated and uncorrected (exploratory).
equity_curve compounds entries one-at-a-time in entry-date order (ignores overlap) — a sanity curve, not a backtested P&L.
note: (1) TOUCH hit-rate (a Close reached +pct — optimistic, sold-the-top; Wilson CI). (2) STRATEGY EV: enter at the signal close, hold to window end, exit at that Close (no look-ahead).
